title: A Hyena That Can't Chew Meat Eats 300,000 Termites a Night

scenes.text: This hyena would starve at a kill.
It's the aardwolf, the smallest of the four hyenas, about ten kilograms.
Its cheek teeth are flat pegs. It can't chew meat. It has never needed to.
At night it walks up to 12 kilometres, lapping up harvester termites with a long, sticky tongue.
Those termites spray a toxic defence that other animals won't touch. The aardwolf licks them up anyway, up to 300,000 in one night.
It barely needs to drink. The termites are its water too. Put it at a kill, and it would starve.

description:
The aardwolf is a hyena that cannot chew meat: its cheek teeth are reduced to pegs, and it lives almost entirely on termites, up to 300,000 in a single night.
It feeds on harvester termites whose toxic secretions other animals avoid, walks 8 to 12 km a night to find them, and gets most of its water from them.
Which animal has the strangest diet you know?
subject: aardwolf
first_comment: Its tongue is tough enough to shrug off termite bites, and it keeps its fangs only for fighting. Which other predator secretly lives on bugs?
